newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - ZAMBIA SUGAR LEADS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - ZAMBIA SUGAR LEADS TRADE.

text.p: Traded volume on the Lusaka stock
exchange fell in the week ended March 14, exchange officials
They said volume fell to 216,205 shares valued at 4,859,601
kwacha from 464,117 shares worth 7,976,968 the previous week.
Zambia Sugar remained steady at 15 kwacha and saw 155,950
shares valued at 2,339,250 kwacha exchanging hands.
Rothmans closed at 32 kwacha, down six kwacha in a traded
Farmers House gained 10 kwacha to end the week at 180 kwacha
in a traded volume of 350 shares valued at 63,000 kwacha while
Chilanga Cement gained 9.75 kwacha to end the week at 70 kwacha
in a traded volume of 20,700 shares valued at 1,349,300 kwacha.
